title: Aimbot Weapon Editor Esp and More
features:
🔥 D-DAY | Full Combat Utility Script (Aimbot, ESP, Gun Editor, Anti-Mod, Movement Spoof)

An all-in-one script designed for D-DAY with advanced functionality and protection features:

🎯 Aimbot: Customizable FOV-based aimbot with wall check, team check, and headshot priority.
🧠 ESP: Fully featured enemy & ally ESP including boxes, chams, tracers, names, distances, tools, and health bars.
🔫 Weapon Editor: Dynamically modifies any equipped gun’s spread, recoil, fire rate, reload time, intensity, and more.
♾️ Infinite Ammo Toggle: Rewrites internal ammo count without breaking the gun script.
🏃‍♂️ Movement Spoofer: Adjust WalkSpeed, SprintSpeed, JumpPower, and enable Infinite Jump

⚠️ Note: I did NOT create this script. All credits go to the original developer.
